column1: # skill-sources.tsv -- where every third-party skill in ~/.claude/skills comes from,
# and how it is kept current. Consumed by scripts/update-skills.sh (weekly, from the
# SessionStart hook and bootstrap.sh) and by scripts/install-third-party-skills.sh
# A skill copied into ~/.claude/skills has no memory of where it came from. Without
# a recorded upstream + pinned commit nobody can tell whether it is current, whether
# a local edit exists, or how to refresh it -- which is why, before 2026-08-18, only
# 1 of 114 skills (ponytail, via a hand-written PROVENANCE.md) could be updated at all,
# and clone-mode skills registered here were missing on devices that never re-ran
# bootstrap. This table makes "is it current?" answerable by a script.
#   mode     clone  = the whole upstream repo is git-cloned to skills/<skill>/ and is
#                     entry and this row must always exist together)
#            vendor = files copied at <pinned> from <path> inside <repo>, tracked in
#                     this config repo like any other file
#   path     path inside the repo: a directory, a single file (only that file is
#            vendored, e.g. ponytail), or . for the repo root
#   pinned   full commit hash the local copy was verified against, or - when the local
#            copy matches no upstream commit (then policy is effectively review until
#            someone pins it). For clone rows this is informational only.
#   policy   track  = when upstream changes, apply automatically: files you never
#                     touched are replaced; files you edited get a 3-way merge
#                     conflict downgrades that skill to review for this run
#            review = never write; report the diff and leave the merge to a human
#            pin    = never write, never report (deliberately frozen)
# HOW pinned WAS ESTABLISHED (2026-08-18): for each skill the upstream history was
# scanned for the newest commit whose files, compared as sorted "blob-sha relpath"
# lines (mode-agnostic; PROVENANCE.md, __pycache__ and *.pyc ignored), equal the local
# copy. "frontmatter-only" means the ONLY local difference at that commit is the
# SKILL.md front matter (descriptions rewritten to trigger-scenario style in the
# 2026-07 skill audit); "exact" means byte-identical. Rows with pinned=- matched no
# TO ADD a skill: vendor it (copy the upstream path in), then add a row with the
# commit you copied from and policy=track. Run
# to confirm it reports "current". Skills authored in this repo (dream-skin-*,
# codex-video-skin, humanizer_academic, claudeception, ...) do NOT belong here.
# TO REMOVE a skill from tracking: delete its row (the files stay).
# --- clone mode (whole repo, .gitignore'd; installed by install-third-party-skills.sh) ---
